title: Letter from Amarith
summary: Read this letter to unlock placing an Autumncrocus on Myrna’s grave for 25 XP.

fields.Grave offering: Read before interacting with Myrna’s grave in the Dread Hollow. If it is still undisturbed, place an Autumncrocus there for 25 XP and approval from Gale, Karlach and Wyll.
fields.Acquisition: On Lenore’s desk in the Arcane Tower bedroom, X −28, Y −295. It is called Handwritten Letter before the first read.

changes: Pinned the reading unlock, XP reward, acquisition, and approval interaction.
